content.short: C6 Bank is a Brazilian digital bank with accounts, cards, a global account, investments and SME tools.
content.description: C6 Bank, launched in 2019 and part-owned by JPMorgan, is one of Brazil's largest digital banks, serving tens of millions of individuals and small businesses. Through its app it offers free checking accounts, credit and debit cards, a global account for spending abroad, investments, loans and the C6 Tag for contactless payments, plus products for small companies. Customers handle everyday banking, Pix instant transfers, bill payments and international spending from one mobile app. It bundles accounts, cards, credit and investments, competing with incumbent Brazilian banks and other digital challengers.
